title: Mr. Glessner looks himself beside you in the brougham
items: Riding in the Glessner brougham on a phone or lighter detail, Mr. Glessner had no hair, spectacles or moustache and a coarse face. He now keeps his near figure in the cab on every device.
His hands rest on his thighs instead of hanging down beside his shins.
His crown is no longer bare: a thin cover of short white hair is combed back over it, as his 1897 portrait shows. His card's likeness is redrawn to match.
